# M0.2 orchestration final bounded re-review v1

**Verdict: NOT_ACCEPTED_FOR_BOUNDED_M0_2_PURPOSE.** M02-SK-05 is CLOSED. Numeric assignment-head resolution within M02-SK-02 is CLOSED, but M02-SK-02 remains PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED because a schema-valid expected handoff can explicitly describe another task and still authorize dispatch. M02-SK-08 remains PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED because denial receipts omit handoff and typed dependency-completion records consumed by the denial path. Both residuals are MEDIUM and materially violate explicit current-scope acceptance requirements. M02-SK-09 remains CLOSED; no new BLOCKER or HIGH exists.

## Scope and preservation

This review consumed `H-M0-037.v1` and Director completion `H-M0-036.v3` at synchronized Director base `a78a68d575bfc3ebf7e6da2719aa6ee7d8469887`, then claimed in `H-M0-037.v2`. It reviewed only numeric assignment/dependency heads, handoff/task consistency, denial receipt context, final owner coherence and representative closed regressions. Production controls and Director evidence were read-only. Historical v1-v6 and Director-base blobs are frozen in `reports/skeptic-orchestration-final-bounded-rereview/preservation.v1.json`.

## M02-SK-02 — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED (MEDIUM residual)

The shared resolver uses strict decimal `v<N>` parsing and numeric maximum selection. Active v1/v2/v9/v10 followed by completed v2/v10/v10/v11/v100 denies as appropriate. Active v100 remains authoritative over stale completed v10 and dispatches. Newer BLOCKED or YIELDED/non-active heads deny. Missing, malformed and leading-zero ambiguous representations deny. Exact task, attempt, owner, writer, handoff reference and claim generation mutations deny. Adding the legitimate completed handoff makes the positive temporary fixture deny, and the checked-in completed claim denies.

The requested handoff/task attack still succeeds. A schema-valid current H-M0-036 v2 at the exact expected reference can state that it claims only unrelated `T-OTHER` attempt 77, while the typed assignment claims `T-SYNTHETIC-001` attempt 1; the engine returns `DISPATCH`. The handoff remains part of the claimed current assignment chain, so accepting a direct contradiction violates the explicit bounded consistency requirement unless the repository contract first makes narrative handoff content non-authoritative in a machine-checkable way.

## M02-SK-05 — CLOSED

Completed v2 plus blocked or incomplete v10 denies. Completed v2 plus completed v10 evaluates v10 and succeeds only with v10's exact evidence. Completed v9 plus blocked v10, completed v10 plus blocked v11, and completed v10 plus blocked v100 deny. Completed v100 remains authoritative over stale v10. Stale v2 evidence referenced from v10 denies. Missing, malformed and leading-zero ambiguous heads deny. The current completion record binds task ID, attempt, exact task path, `COMPLETED` status and task-content SHA-256. Self, two-node and transitive cycles remain denied. No authenticated-worker guarantee is claimed.

## M02-SK-08 — PARTIALLY_REMEDIATED (MEDIUM residual)

Denial receipts now bind canonical scheduler state, project JSON records, STOP inventory, assignment heads, task heads and capabilities. Project, STOP, assignment, dependency-task head, capability, task and writer-state changes with a constant reason change the receipt. Repeated identical context is stable, property ordering is canonical, and different denied subjects differ.

Two decision-critical namespaces remain omitted: `docs/handoffs` and `orchestration/completions`. Changing the content digest in a typed dependency completion from all-zero to all-one preserves the same completion-binding denial reason and the same receipt. Changing a completed superseding handoff's request content likewise preserves the same currentness denial reason and receipt. These records are actually consumed by `_current_handoff` and `_validate_dependencies`; omitting them makes the stated denial content binding incomplete. This is local deterministic binding, not authentication or append-only evidence.

## M02-SK-09 and representative regressions

Both final owner modules pass 8/8. The positive case uses a temporary pre-completion H-M0-036 v2 fixture; checked-in completed v3 denies. v7 is the current semantic successor and passes all 24 probes. Historical v1-v6 remain immutable.

Strict attempt typing, complete STOP discovery, repository containment, completion/review fail-closed behavior and unified mandatory capability semantics pass representative checks. The valid temporary task/assignment/claim/writer/dependency/capability/project/STOP fixture returns `DISPATCH` with `execution_adapter: MOCK_ONLY` and causes no external effect.

## Deferred boundaries and state

Authenticated append-only scheduler/evidence, authenticated worker/reviewer identity, transactional scheduler state, typed executor boundary, model/usage policy and authenticated sequenced receipts remain FUTURE_GATE. Formal assignment/completion schemas and broader validator inventory remain LOW M0.3 hardening. Neither category caused this rejection.

`STOP-M0-001` remains OPEN; M0 blocked; M1 and Scout unreleased; executor `MOCK_ONLY`; conceptual bankroll USD 50; deployable/reserved USD 0; live `LOCKED`; kill `ENGAGED`; no operational activity occurred.

Stage 1 is not frozen. Director may schedule only the narrowly targeted handoff/receipt closure; M0.3 Runtime Foundation must not become the next executable milestone yet.
